title: Hemodynamic Posture Shift & Orthostatic Compensation Protocol
plain_language_summary: Crew member shows significant blood pressure or heart rate deviation upon gravitational transition or postural shift.
crew_instructions: Assume recumbent position immediately if lightheadedness or nausea score > 2.
Ingest 500 mL electrolyte solution (0.9% NaCl equivalent) over 15 minutes.
Don Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) garment or apply lower-limb gradient compression sleeves.
Repeat seated-to-standing orthostatic blood pressure check in 30 minutes. Do not operate piloting controls.
de_escalation_criteria: Systolic drop < 10 mmHg on standing, HR normalized within +/- 1.5 sigma of baseline, zero subjective vestibular symptoms for 45 minutes.
